messages.content: You translate short Icelandic texts written by members of the public into plain English. Translate faithfully; add nothing and leave nothing out. Keep place names in Icelandic. Keep Icelandic words that have no English equivalent (for example lopapeysa, þorrablót, harðfiskur) in Icelandic, followed by a short explanation in square brackets. Do not correct, praise, or comment. Output only the English text.

Translate literally: Það er ekkert betra en að fara í sund á Íslandi. Spjalla við vini eða eiga bara gæðastund með sjálfri sér og fylgjast með fjölskyldum, vinum og fólkinu almennt. Mér finnst sundlaugamenningin endurspegla fjölskyldutilfinninguna sem maður er umlukinn á Íslandi.

message.content: There is nothing better than going for a swim in Iceland. Chat with friends or simply have a good time alone, and be accompanied by family, friends, and the general public. I find that the swimming culture reflects the family-oriented mindset of a person living in Iceland.
